rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday verb when you mean motivate or encourage someone.

example.english: You always inspire me, giving me the courage to keep trying.
example.traditional: 你成日鼓勵我，令我有勇氣繼續試。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 gu2 lai6 ngo5 ling6 ngo5 jau5 jung5 hei3 gai3 zuk6 si3

rows.note: Use this for the physical act of drawing air into the lungs.

example.english: Before the scan, please inspire slowly through your nose.
example.traditional: 做檢查之前，請用鼻慢慢吸氣。
example.jyutping: zou6 gim2 caa4 zi1 cin4 ceng2 jung6 bei6 maan6 maan6 kap1 hei3
